description: US producer price index for wood pulp (BLS series WPU0911, via FRED), monthly index value. This is a price index, not the RISI Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) benchmark; the route name is kept for the owner. Latest value plus up to 24 months of history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: commodities_fao_food_price_index when you need FAO Food Price Index monthly values from the FAO CSV; commodities_steel_rebar_hrc_futures when you need US producer price index for steel mill products, monthly. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
